hero.title: Hungary Golden Visa: invest in a bright, stable future
hero.text: The Guest Investor Residence Permit lets you and your family hold a 10-year residence permit in the heart of Europe with no minimum stay requirement, and enjoy the valuable benefits of life in the European Union.

opportunity.title: An opportunity for today and tomorrow
opportunity.text: Hungary's Golden Visa is more than a simple residence permit. It is a bridge to growth and financial security in Europe, where you can find freedom, comfort and wide opportunities in a stable environment. We are with you to make every step of the Golden Visa process as simple as possible.

options.title: Three options for a secure investment
options.text: Hungary's Guest Investor Residence programme offers three investment routes, each designed for different needs and goals:

items.title: Real estate fund investment
items.text: Buy units worth at least €250,000 in a real estate investment fund registered with the Hungarian National Bank (MNB) and hold them for at least 5 years. You and your family members receive a 10-year residence permit that can be renewed.

items.title: Residential property in Hungary
items.text: Buy a residential property worth at least €500,000, purchased after 1 January 2025 and kept in your ownership for at least 5 years. Besides security and added value for your capital, this option lets you live and work in Europe.

items.title: Donation to higher education
items.text: Make a non-refundable donation of €1 million to a higher education institution maintained by a public trust foundation, supporting education, scientific research or artistic creation, a route that also carries the meaningful sense of contributing to society.

benefits.title: Benefits of the Hungary Golden Visa

items.title: No stay requirement
items.text: You do not need to live in Hungary permanently, and you can travel in the Schengen area for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

items.title: Work and business
items.text: Permit holders may work and do business in Hungary and grow their companies.

items.title: Residence for your family
items.text: Your spouse, children under 18 and dependent parents can receive residence together with the main applicant.

quiz.title: How much do you know about Hungary?

items.text: Did you know Hungary is a Central European country and a member of both the European Union and the Schengen area?
Did you know that with a Hungarian residence permit you can travel visa-free to the 29 Schengen countries for short stays?
Did you know Budapest, known as the "Pearl of the Danube", welcomes millions of visitors every year?

quiz.closing: The big news: you can obtain residency in this European country through the Golden Visa!

items.q: How long is the Hungary Golden Visa valid?
items.a: The Guest Investor Residence Permit is issued for 10 years and, if the conditions are still met, can be renewed once for another 10 years.

items.q: Do I have to live in Hungary?
items.a: No. The programme has no minimum stay requirement in Hungary. Travel within other Schengen countries is possible for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

items.q: Which family members can receive residence?
items.a: The main applicant's spouse, children under 18 and dependent parents can receive dependent residence permits, which include the right to work.

items.q: How long must I keep the investment?
items.a: For the real estate fund and property routes, the investment must be kept for at least 5 years. The €1 million donation is non-refundable.

items.q: Does a property bought before 2025 qualify?
items.a: No. For the property route, only residential properties purchased after 1 January 2025 qualify.

items.q: Does the Golden Visa lead to permanent residence or citizenship?
items.a: This permit does not by itself lead to permanent residence or Hungarian citizenship. Speak with our advisors about next steps that suit your situation.
